name: look-mum-no-hands
description: Expose the Look Mum No Hands macOS automation MCP server to Codex with an agent skill for safe desktop inspection and control.

interface.shortDescription: Use local macOS accessibility automation through MCP.
interface.longDescription: Look Mum No Hands packages a Swift MCP server for macOS UI inspection, virtual cursor targeting, accessibility actions, focusless clicks, and text entry. The bundled skill gives agents a compact workflow for checking permissions, taking UI snapshots, finding elements, and acting without moving the real mouse when possible.
defaultPrompt: Use Look Mum No Hands to inspect my desktop.
Find and click a visible macOS UI element.
